name: Finding the Antidote
summary: Kor'ghan in Orgrimmar races to brew a cure for the poisoned hunter Rhinag. You gather venomtail poison sacs from scorpids outside the city walls before their venom proves fatal. Durotar's wildlife is unforgiving, and survival depends on wilderness preparation.

sections.title: A Race Against the Venom
sections.body: Rhinag, a Darkspear troll, was hunting in Durotar when he faced venomtail scorpids without an antidote. Their potent venom struck quickly, leaving him in need of immediate aid. Kor'ghan, an experienced hunter in Orgrimmar, must mix a draught before the poison kills him.

sections.title: Crafting the Cure
sections.body: Mature venomtail scorpids outside Orgrimmar's gates carry the sacs Kor'ghan needs to make an antidote. He says there will be time to chastise Rhinag for going unprepared, but every moment matters now. Bring the sacs back into the city, and Kor'ghan can brew the draught for the dying hunter.

faq.answer: Rhinag is a Darkspear troll hunter in Durotar. Venomtails stung him while he was tracking beasts, and without an antidote he now depends on aid from Orgrimmar before the poison overwhelms him.
Kor'ghan is an experienced Darkspear troll hunter in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow. He knows Durotar's beasts and can brew a counter-venom from venomtail poison sacs.

faq.q: Where do the required venom sacs come from?
faq.answer: The venom sacs come from venomtail scorpids outside Orgrimmar, on the rocky, arid ground near the city's entrance.

faq.q: Why is there an active time limit on this task?
faq.answer: Rhinag's health is failing in the field. Venomtail toxins act quickly, so Kor'ghan needs the ingredients in time to brew a cure before Rhinag dies of poisoning.

faq.q: What lesson does Kor'ghan emphasize during this hunt?
faq.answer: Kor'ghan warns hunters to study their quarry and its dangers before they engage. Entering the wilderness without proper preparation or countermeasures can cost a warrior their life.

faq.q: How does this task fit with 'Need for a Cure'?
faq.answer: 'Need for a Cure' begins the emergency and starts the timer. Finding the Antidote is the intermediary step: you gather the raw components Kor'ghan needs to brew the finished concoction.

angles.text: As a hunter, you hear Kor'ghan's stern reminder: know a beast's venom and carry the right remedies, alongside your bow and tracking skills.
As an orc newly settled in Durotar, you face a test of endurance. Even a seasoned scout can fall to the land's native hazards through carelessness.
As a member of the Horde in Durotar, you look after your own. Isolated rangers and scouts on the perimeter can rely on Orgrimmar for aid.
